requires: Same consenting test user signed in on two physical devices; use synthetic learning work and preserve/export existing work before restores.

steps.action: On device A, save a synthetic tutor conversation to the account and record its title.
On device B, sign in to the same account, open Account and review/restore the cloud copy after backing up local work.
steps.pass: Exact conversation title and text match device A.

steps.action: With both devices holding the same account revision, save a change from A, then attempt to save a different change from B before refreshing B.
steps.pass: B warns of a changed account record and does not overwrite A; B retains its local work.

steps.action: On B, review the newer account copy and explicitly choose the version to continue.
steps.pass: Both devices can read the selected version without unexplained data loss.

steps.action: Sign out on B, then attempt account saving.
steps.pass: Sign-in is required; browser work remains available.

limitations: Simulated clients passing is not physical-device verification.
